_about: Which OnMyLead version riders can actually get. The Help Center only publishes articles (and :::release blocks) for versions that are live. The build asks Apple which version is live (the free App Store lookup for the bundle ID) and falls back to `live` below when Apple can't be reached. See help/README.md. `publishAhead` publishes that version's guides before Apple releases it (owner's call); remove it once the App Store has it.

prelaunch.notice: OnMyLead 1.0 for iPhone, iPad and Android is with Apple and Google for store review. These guides describe that first release.

versions.notes: First release, now for iPhone and iPad: everything through PR #116. Replaced build 2 (ad388f4, submitted 2026-10-13) in review. The same code goes to Google Play for Android phones and tablets.
Includes the unreleased 1.0.2. Android versionCode 7. Live on the App Store and Google Play 2026-11-02.

Everything through PR #171 (notifications inbox, accurate location, Leave Ride hand-off, Full Map, Follow Me, Freeride rider line, Ride Mode messages, Update Available, Music Controls, ride miles fix). Android versionCode 8. Named 2.0 by Chris (was planned as 1.0.4). Live on the App Store and Google Play 2026-11-04.

Bluetooth Sharing with no service, Emergency Siren, Map Settings, Your Dot styles, 3D Terrain, every map on Mapbox, Leader Trackline, group spread, Badge Leaderboard, group photos, CarPlay, Edit Ride Details, Rider Agreement v2. Bluetooth Sharing, custom dots, group photo upload and CarPlay are Pro, with a fresh 30-day Pro trial for every rider without Pro. Android versionCode 10 (9 was halted). Approved by Chris on his phones and submitted to both stores 2026-11-06. Website, Help Center and release notes published 2026-11-06 while the App Store and Google Play reviews finish (Chris: "lets just go live now with everything since we are just waiting on apple").

First store release of 3.0 (the redesign, Map Mode up front, Make It a Group Ride, event group invites, Starlink on Home, photo crop, Show Password, CarPlay in Map Mode, Ad Measurement) plus the Map Mode Follow Me edge fix. 3.0 (11) was uploaded but never submitted: both stores refused it until the privacy answers said Ad Measurement tracks. Android versionCode 12. App Privacy and Play Data safety / Advertising ID updated 2026-11-11 with Chris's OK. iOS build 12 came back as Invalid Binary (privacy manifest had tracking on with no tracking domains); build 13 lists them and replaced it in review on 2026-11-11. Android stays versionCode 12 (live on Play 2026-11-11). Live on Google Play 2026-11-11 and approved by Apple 2026-11-11 (auto-release).

The map on CarPlay (Apple granted CarPlay Navigation 2026-11-13) with turn-by-turn from the trail's shape, CarPlay Messages (hear and one-tap reply), and Exit in Map Mode and Ride Mode (plus Android Back). Android versionCode 13. Two clean test passes on the iPhone Simulator and Android emulator; the CarPlay screens could not be opened in the simulator, and Chris chose to submit without a truck check. Submitted to both stores 2026-11-13 ~15:50Z with automatic release on approval. iOS build 14 pulled from App Review 2026-11-13 ~18:20Z (Chris OK) after his truck test: the car map had no trails or roads and no messages without a ride; iOS build 15 adds them (Android versionCode 13 stays in review: no CarPlay there).

unreleased.why: Not supported. Sharing a post to Instagram (2.0) is fine; signing in with Instagram is not.
